name: a-red-gated-job-stays-in-the-duration-series
find:
if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.already.outputs.run != 'false' }}
        run: echo "swift-unit ran its checks on tree $(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})"
replace:
if: steps.already.outputs.run != 'false'
        run: echo "swift-unit ran its checks on tree $(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})"
breaks: a job that went red drops out of the duration series, which hides a job getting slower right up to the moment it breaks (#990, #1019)
